maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for streaming/chat reliability: need owners + deadlines for reconnect/backoff, partial-shortcircuit, telemetry, repro harness, and canary comms. Keeping this tight so we can schedule the remediation sprint.

jason: I'll own reconnect/backoff in SDK and server handshake policy. Plan: RFC by 2026-03-26, PRs by 2026-04-03, canary 2026-04-10. Default: exponential backoff, max_attempts=5, jitter 10-20%.

rina: Obs lead. Will add metric stream.partial_rate (per-model+route), handshake latency p50/p95/p99, and alert: sustained partial_rate >0.5% for 10m or instant spike >1%. Dashboard + small runbook. Target: 2026-03-29.

tom: I'll build a lightweight repro harness that injects truncated chunks and network flaps, add nightly CI job, and attach a minimal repro script to the ticket. Target: 2026-03-28.

jason: Config draft to discuss: {"streaming":{"reconnect":{"enabled":true,"strategy":"exp","initial_ms":100,"max_ms":1600,"max_attempts":5,"jitter_fraction":0.15}}}

triage-bot: Created tickets: RW-STREAM-1101 (jason), RW-STREAM-1102 (rina), RW-STREAM-1103 (tom).

maya: Server short-circuit rule: if a request accumulates repeated partials above threshold, mark event=partial_shortcircuit, trigger safe-fallback (no progressive retries), and persist KV snapshot to logs for 30s for triage. Product-facing comms draft required before customer-visible canary.

rina: Will tag logs with partial_shortcircuit and add trace correlation. Dashboard will include request-id drilldowns linking KV snapshots.

jason: Noted runtime risk: reconnect storms could affect continuous batching; will sync with eng-runtime and add a client-side reconnect throttle if needed.

triage-bot: Planned canary window: 2026-04-10 01:00-05:00 UTC (region: us-central1). Auto-rollback if partial_rate >0.9% or handshake p99 increases >120ms.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged, canary stable 48h with metric improvement vs baseline, telemetry retained 14d, then retrospective and close actions. 15m prep sync Friday.
